database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. At the configured 30-second interval this is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: Owner approved dedicated Production database on Prisma Free ($0, fixed 200,000-operation shared workspace cap; no paid upgrade or overages). Direct Console plan and $0 invoice last confirmed 5 November; current billing is not exposed through CLI. At 08:31 UTC Prisma CLI measured 11,310 Production operations. The sum across all nine databases in all five enumerated projects was 38,451 at 08:17 UTC, a derived estimate rather than the direct Console workspace meter. Production backup inventory at 08:31 UTC showed zero backups and zero retention. Production database is ready and lists six credential records; per-credential health is unavailable. One manual dump/restore drill passed once; Free has no automatic backups, and recurring backup/restore ownership and cadence remain open.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: At the 2026-11-06 08:17 UTC derived workspace estimate of 38,451/200,000, about 161,549 operations remained. Based only on one operation per successful room poll, this equates to about 336 two-hour two-player or 168 four-player sessions before other queries. Two tabs polling continuously every 30 seconds add an estimated 172,800 operations per 30-day month; four tabs add 345,600. These remain estimates, not measured capacity acceptance.
